name: Kamizono Mayu
source:
She thinks [url=/c6397]Masaki[/url] looks a little like the man in an old photograph she found in her mother’s possessions after her death. She’s since taken an interest in him as a member of the opposite sex and intends to ask him about it.

"Your medicine is ready."

[From [url=https://www.mangagamer.com/r18/detail.php?goods_type=0&product_code=139l]MangaGamer[/url]]
